relevant_lessons: - [2026-06-27] (landing, design, eva) A tall, narrow single-stack lander tipped over on Duna, burying the hatch and blocking both the flag and the ascent. Design for a tip-over angle well above the expected slopes (wide stance, low centre of mass) and check tilt before any surface ignition.

- [2026-06-27] (mechjeb, staging, capture) MechJeb's StagingController is separate from the ascent autostage flag: the landing autopilot and an autostaging ascent leave it active, and it autostages during ANY later burn. It fired a heat-shield/payload decoupler mid-capture and stranded a crew pod at Eve with no engine, shield, or chutes. Release it before every in-space burn.
- [2026-06-27] (landing, reentry) A propulsive Duna landing worked without parachutes: aerobrake from ~1,300 to ~400 m/s, then a powered landing to 0 m/s.

- [2026-06-27] (warp, reentry) No physics warp during powered ascent or the terminal landing phase, and no warp at all during a hot atmospheric entry: heating is applied in coarse steps under warp and two crews were destroyed that way.

- [2026-06-27] (eva) Planting a flag needs the vessel landed or splashed; boarding uses a nearby crewable part with a free seat; confirm re-boarding with the EVA status. Treat the flag as optional so a failed EVA never strands the crew.

- [2026-06-27] (landing) A touchdown KSP accepts is not necessarily relaunchable: after a 6 m/s touchdown the ascent slid and destroyed the stage; after 2 m/s sideways only the pod survived. Before a surface ascent: settle until speeds stay near zero, keep legs deployed through liftoff, use partial throttle until clear, retract legs once off the ground.

- [2026-06-27] (interplanetary, budget) A real crewed Kerbin-to-Duna transfer cost ~3,100 m/s (ejection ~1,039 + corrections ~890 + capture and circularization ~1,176) against ~1,688 m/s modelled, with MechJeb execution overhead ~25%. No fixed transfer-stage margin both launched and captured; precise ejection and cheap capture mattered more than bigger tanks.

- [2026-06-27] (mechjeb) The old /mj-disable could not stop the ascent autopilot, the landing autopilot, or the node executor (only docking, rendezvous, staging); switching vessel or reloading was the only way to abort them.

args.text: Duna window is open and flat (ejection ~1077 m/s from an 80 km orbit, capture ~618 m/s to 60 km at Duna, 329 days). Launched at KSC dawn. MechJeb ascent with auto-staging down to stage 2 (transfer Terrier finishes the orbit).

args.text: Duna entry, descent and landing like Mars: deorbit 25.9 m/s at 90 E to a 12 km periapsis; aerobrake retrograde through the thin air; chutes (Mk16 + 2 Mk2-R) once below ~260 m/s; then fly_descent (predictor guidance, terrain look-ahead, drift < 0.5 m/s) for the powered touchdown. The footprint (60-120 deg past the burn) lies in daylight.

args.summary: Valentina landed on Duna (Midland Sea, 6.97 N 39.95 W) and planted 'ASTRA Duna Base'. MechJeb ascent; Lambert window (ejection 1091 m/s applied), two mid-course corrections, capture 713 m/s into 63x52 km with auto-staging; aerobraking entry to 6 km/411 m/s, three parachutes, then the height-first fly_descent touched down at 1.22 m/s vertical, 0.01 m/s horizontal. The HECS2 probe core kept SAS on with the crew out and the lander stayed upright through the jetpack-hop EVA, the flag and boarding. One-way mission: the lander has ~1300 m/s but no ascent vehicle for Duna's gravity well.
